$comment: Xedge Development Tools Configuration File - Complete Reference

apps.name: another_app
apps.$comment: Second example with absolute path and auto-reload disabled

$apps_comment: Array of Xedge applications to manage. Each app needs: name (identifier), path (absolute or relative), autoReload (true/false for file watching)
$localIp_comment: REQUIRED: IP address of the machine running VSCode and Mako WebDAV server. ESP32 will fetch app files from this IP. Find your IP with: ip addr show | grep 'inet ' | grep -v 127.0.0.1 (Linux) or ipconfig (Windows)

esp32.$ip_comment: ESP32 device IP address. Set this to your ESP32's IP address on the network. Example: 192.168.0.102

$usage_notes.debounce_delay: 500ms delay to batch multiple file changes
$usage_notes.fsname_source: Read from server.conf in extension directory
commands: Xedge: Load Application to ESP32 - Load specific app
Xedge: Reload Current Application - Quick reload (Ctrl+Shift+R)
Xedge: Reload All Applications - Reload all configured apps
Xedge: Check Application Status - View running status
Xedge: Restart ESP32 Device - Full device restart
Xedge: Start/Stop/Restart Mako WebDAV Server - Server control
Xedge: Show Extension Logs - View detailed logs
Xedge: Create Default Configuration File - Create this file
workflow: 1. Update localIp to your machine's IP address
2. Update esp32.ip to your ESP32's IP address
3. Mako server starts automatically when extension loads
6. Edit files and auto-reload will happen!
